mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate indicates an accommodative monetary policy, which may stimulate economic growth and lead to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative returns in more than 40% of the 20-day periods following low FEDFUNDS.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate above 5% may signal economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive returns in more than 50% of the 20-day periods following an unemployment rate increase above 5%.

mechanism_narrative: Strong GDP growth coupled with high inflation may lead to supply chain constraints, negatively impacting S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive returns in more than 60% of the 60-day periods following strong GDP growth with high inflation.

mechanism_narrative: High industrial production indicates strong economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative returns in more than 30% of the 20-day periods following high industrial production.

mechanism_narrative: Increasing non-farm payroll employment suggests a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative returns in more than 40% of the 5-day periods following payroll increases.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production may indicate a slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive returns in more than 50% of the 60-day periods following an industrial production decline.

mechanism_narrative: Rising federal funds rate alongside low unemployment may signal tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive returns in more than 40% of the 20-day periods following rising FEDFUNDS and low UNRATE.

mechanism_narrative: High real sales suggest strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative returns in more than 30% of the 60-day periods following high real sales growth.
